name: agent-guide-unbranded-inert
body: The embedded AGENTS.md guide content must remain unbranded (no corporate branding and no reference to files under `brand/`), text-only and offline, format-accurate (no drift from the format the code implements; see agent-guide-drift-check), and inert: written verbatim by scaffolding, permitted by the library layout only as the single non-template root entry (library-guide-layout), and never read by the load/validate/render/serve/list code paths. It is not a template asset and must not be referenced as one.
